All 15 paid score sheets in one file

Pick an assessment from the list. It opens right here.

  • You can switch between tools. Each one keeps what you typed until you clear it or close this file.
  • To print a report, use the Print button inside that tool. Only that tool's report prints.
  • When you finish with a client, press New client: clear all. It empties every tool at once.
  • Each score sheet has its own Contrast and text size buttons. The Menu contrast button at the top changes this menu only.
  • Nothing typed here is sent anywhere or saved on this computer.
